{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue (though not needed for conversion rate)
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Drop refunded orders for conversion rate (only completed count as converted)
completed_orders = real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate = completed_orders.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate.idxmax()

# Print results
print(f"Conversion rates by segment:\n{conversion_rate}")
print(f"Highest conversion rate segment: {best_segment}")"}
